items.title: From dream to journey’s end: Why distribution is the quiet hero of the AI travel era
items.snippet: Amadeus argues that as AI assistants simplify hotel discovery, the complexity shifts to distribution, requiring structured content, intent-carrying systems, and seamless servicing to convert traveler queries into bookable, adaptable offers.

items.title: Marriott Bonvoy Sign-Ins Were Down for Hours
items.snippet: Skift Take: Marriott’s website and app briefly blocked loyalty member log-ins Tuesday. The company says the outage wasn’t a cyberattack. United Airlines and many non-travel companies have suffered various tech disruptions in recent days. Members of Marriott's loyalty program had trouble signing in Tuesday, with problems affecting access through its website and mobile app.

items.title: The Comeback of Independent Bookstores: Why Readers Are Returning
items.snippet: Independent bookstores are flourishing across America, attracting younger readers with curated selections, author events and community spaces that offer something online retailers and algorithms cannot replicate: genuine human connection today.

items.title: Radisson Dining Makes Global Debut in India, Targets F&B Growth
items.snippet: Radisson Hotel Group has selected India for the global launch of Radisson Dining, a subscription-based programme designed to drive local engagement through dining, spa and hotel stay benefits. The initiative aims to extend the group’s customer engagement beyond hotel stays while generating incremental food and beverage (F&B) business for its properties.

items.title: Arizona’s VAI Resort adds Barbie Hotel, another Mattel-branded concept
items.snippet: The two hotels will add more than 800 rooms to the Glendale entertainment destination as travelers seek immersive, branded experiences. The new hotels will bring Mattel Inc. brands to life through “immersive, family-friendly environments, one-of-a-kind themed suites and indoor entertainment,” per the release.

items.title: Radisson Hotel Group expands loyalty offering, selects India for global launch of Radisson Dining
items.snippet: Radisson Hotel Group has announced the launch of Radisson Dining in India, a subscription-based dining and lifestyle benefits programme developed in partnership with TLC DigiTech. Available from December 1, 2026, the initiative will extend the group’s Radisson Rewards loyalty ecosystem beyond hotel stays, offering local consumers benefits across dining, spa and accommodation at participating properties.

items.title: HKTB inks MoU with Consensus to Host Asia’s Flagship AI, Blockchain and Digital Assets Conference from 2027 to 2029
items.snippet: The Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with CoinDesk, a media, events, indices and data platform for the global digital asset economy, officially establishing a strategic partnership.

items.title: Meghalaya Tourism and Evoke Experiences launch ‘Living Meghalaya’ luxury tented stays across three destinations
items.snippet: The Department of Tourism, Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Evoke Experiences, has unveiled ‘Living Meghalaya’, a collection of luxury tented accommodation across three destinations in the state. The initiative aims to promote experiential tourism by combining distinctive natural settings, curated hospitality and locally rooted cultural experiences.

items.title: Delhi is our home market; we want to establish our brands here first: Chaitanya Mathur, Ninecamp Ventures
items.snippet: With a focus on consolidating its Delhi NCR presence before entering other markets, Ninecamp Ventures is pursuing a measured expansion strategy while building a multi-brand F&B business across distinct dining formats.
